BiblicalUsage: Isaiah says the people take delight in approaching God, and the psalmist says it is good for me to draw near to God. The word is the nearness itself — not the ritual, but the coming close.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe drawing near to God is the good itself, not the price of it, because the psalmist found his good there, and so will I.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
